content: Tell me the time now and calculate how many hours it is from now to tomorrow 2 am.

Thought: I need to first get the current time to determine the time difference until tomorrow 2 am. The SimpleMCP:get_time tool will provide the current time.
Action: SimpleMCP:get_time[]
Observation: Status: Success, Result: "2026-02-03T03:40:42.793966", Message: Execution successful

Thought: Now that I have the current time, I need to calculate the time difference between now and tomorrow 2:00 AM. The current time is 3:40 AM on February 3rd, 2026. Tomorrow 2:00 AM is 2:00 AM on February 4th, 2026. The difference is 22 hours and 20 minutes. 
Action: Finish[The current time is 3:40 AM. The time until tomorrow 2:00 AM is 22 hours and 20 minutes.]
